item.title: Robin Schulz - Getting to know him a little better - Radio Nano
item.description: Despite his success, the fame and countless air miles, Robin stands firmly with both his feet safely on the ground.

item.title: Shawn Mendes - Getting to know him a little better - Radio Nano
item.description: Not only was Mendes discovered by posting his performances on the Internet, but he also taught himself to play guitar via YouTube.

item.title: The Weeknd - Getting to know him a little better - Radio Nano
item.description: Inspired by legendary Michael Jackson to become a singer, he was later influenced by R&B stars like Aaliyah, Missy Elliott and Timbaland.

item.title: Dua Lipa - Getting to know her a little better - Radio Nano
item.description: Dua Lipa, who identifies her music as dark pop, began posting cover versions of songs by her favorite artists on YouTube when she was 14.

item.title: Billie Eilish - Getting to know her a little better - Radio Nano
item.description: Billie Eilish joined a choir at the age of 8, and by the time she turned 11, she had begun writing and singing her own songs.

item.title: Doja Cat - Getting to know her a little better - Radio Nano
item.description: Doja Cat first rose to prominence with the release of the music video for her song "Mooo!", which went viral in 2018.

item.title: Kim Kardashian files for divorce from Kanye West - Radio Nano -
item.description: "Kimye" has been one of the world's most famous couples. After nearly seven years of marriage, they've now filed for divorce.

item.title: Marilyn Manson Under Police Investigation - Radio Nano -
item.description: The Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department investigates domestic violence allegations against Brian Warner, better known as Marilyn Manson.

item.title: Paris Hilton got engaged on her birthday - Radio Nano
item.description: Paris Hilton (40) spent Valentine’s day as a newly-engaged woman. Her fiancé, Carter Reum (40) popped the big question on her birthday.

item.title: TIX to Eurovision, representing Norway with Fallen Angel - Radio Nano
item.description: TIX won The Norwegian Melodi Grand Prix 2021, and will represent Norway at the Eurovision Song Contest 2021 with the song Fallen Angel.
